equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analysed. Adults are defined by age and vaccination status, at-risk groups by occupation or travel as exposure, and equity appears only as a framework consideration in Methods.

level_alternative.reason: Equity is listed among ACIP Evidence to Recommendations considerations in Methods, which a stricter reader might count as equity raised without an SPD.

notes: Guidance report: coverage and seropositivity figures are cited from earlier studies to frame recommendations, so data_focus is limited and no procedures are recorded. The Rockland County versus national coverage contrast is side by side against a cited national estimate, so scale is null.
